manifest_description:
WikiFactopedia visualizes matter from electrons to organisms.
        
        KEY INSIGHT: Different element fields relay signals at different RESOLUTIONS.
        
        Each level uses same element fields (C, H, N, O, P, S) but organized
        into progressively larger signal relay networks.
        
        All visualizations verified using 4-PRIMITIVE VERIFICATION applied
        identically at each resolution level.
